blocks.text: The business is into organic agriculture majorly production of organic fertilizer from earthworms, black soldier fly farming and azolla farming. Its target market are Organic farmers, seedling propagators, urban gardeners and also livestock farmers. More to this, its structure is sole proprietorship, and its thematic areas is Agribusiness.
